messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Senior Leadership | Energy, Infrastructure, Government Relations and ESG
messages.body:
Dear Zynith Talent Team,

Your Saudi-focused executive-search work across Board, C-suite, GM, VP and Director appointments, including energy, utilities, industrial, infrastructure and government-linked organisations, makes this a strong fit for my profile.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major multinational mining operation.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority. I would welcome confidential consideration for Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, Government Relations, External or Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across sovereign-linked, energy, industrial and infrastructure organisations.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
